snippet.title: The Legend of California - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Legend of California is a multiplayer, action-survival FPS set on the Island of California during the gold rush era.

Explore, gather, craft, build, hunt, and fight your way across a vast untamed frontier. Whether you choose to travel alone or work together with friends, your mission on this mythical island is not just to survive, but thrive. Stay strong, stake your claim, and become the true Legend of California. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2550530/The_Legend_of_California/

Developer: Kintsugiyama
X: https://x.com/kintsugiyama

#indiegame #fps #action #survival #multiplayer
